Also reads the selected vehicle's VIN in: Also reads the selected vehicle's VIN in a separate read-only area. Reads climate, battery/charging settings, vehicle health report, doors/windows/trunk/locking state, climate departure times, charging-location list and each available charging location fairly in sequence. Additional locations lengthen a full cycle. The interval runs from completion of a query until the same area becomes due again; 15 seconds does not promise a full cycle every 15 seconds. Automatic jobs also have a recovery pause of at least 5 seconds or 25% of job duration. Manual commands have priority at safe step boundaries. Errors extend retry intervals up to five minutes; a longer configured minimum still applies. Automatic queries do not synchronize or apply preferences. An existing 0 stays disabled; new instances start at 15.

These also include vehicleAccess for doors/windows/trunk/locking state, departureClimate, departureLocations and a separate area for each detected charging location. Automatic uses the greater of 90 seconds and twice the greater of the minimum interval and estimated full cycle time. fresh confirms a recent app read, not new vehicle measurements. This limit changes neither the query frequency nor the app synchronization notice.

Under climate, targetTemperature, target: Under climate, targetTemperature, targetMode, targetClimateOnUnlock, targetAutoWindowHeating and targetZones save preferences for the next command. Acknowledgement means only saved; observed app values are separate in temperature, mode, climateOnUnlock, autoWindowHeating and zones. Temperature: 16 to 29.5 °C in 0.5 °C steps, only in climate mode; LO and HI are excluded. commands.setTemperature applies only the temperature without starting. commands.applySettings applies only the mode, both switches and zones, without temperature or start/stop. commands.clearSettings clears only these four preferences; commands.clearTemperature retains the app temperature. Start uses the saved snapshot; windowHeating ignores the temperature preference. Without a mode preference, the previous climate behavior is retained. Mode changes during operation are rejected; there is no automatic stop/restart. Zones select additional temperature-related features at the front left, right or both, not separate target temperatures or airflow distribution.
Unlock the phone, sign in to the Volkswa: Unlock the phone, sign in to the Volkswagen app and open the overview of the desired vehicle. Read app and vehicle reads the screen and suggests the current app version and complete vehicle text. Check these values and save them afterward.

commands.refreshCharging reads battery a: commands.refreshCharging reads battery and charging information available in the app: battery.soc in %, battery.rangeKm in km. battery.observedAt is the app read time, not a vehicle telemetry timestamp. commands.synchronize explicitly requests synchronization in the app; success confirms only the request, not its completion at the vehicle. This may take several minutes. battery.lastSyncRequestAt records the last request sent to the app. Normal reading and automatic queries do not synchronize. Under charging, targetSoc (50, 60, 70, 80, 90 or 100), targetReducedAcCurrent, targetAutoUnlockAc and targetOptimizedBatteryUse save preferences; null retains the app setting. Acknowledgement means only saved. commands.applyChargingSettings applies only these four preferences, saves once and checks the values after reopening. commands.clearChargingSettings clears only these four preferences. Save or discard any manual drafts on the phone first. According to the app, optimized battery use allows the high-voltage battery to power app remote control and may affect range; it is not an automatic 80% battery care setting. According to the app, the charge limit does not apply at defined charging locations. No charging start/stop function.
commands.refreshVehicleReport only reads: commands.refreshVehicleReport only reads the vehicle health report; automatic refresh also reads it. All values under vehicleReport are read-only; there are no preferences, control, save or synchronization actions. Reading does not require permission for setting changes. Mileage, service, summary and seven categories are provided separately; additionalTexts and json contain extra texts and the complete normalized report as JSON. synchronizationText is the raw app notice, observedAt only the read time. no_messages means the app reports no messages, not a diagnosis. Unrecognized texts remain unknown; colors or severity of unnamed icons are not invented. Warning scenarios have not yet been tested live.
